summary: Container groups are instance groups that point at OpenShift and run each job in an on-demand pod that exists only for the playbook run (the ephemeral execution model); groups upgraded from before controller 4.0 lose custom pod definitions.
questions: What is a container group in automation controller?
How are container groups different from execution environments?
Do container group pods persist after a job?
Why did my custom pod spec disappear after upgrade?
